**Test image analysis:**
- Sugarcane leaves with prominent longitudinal yellow-green streaks running parallel to veins
- Some leaves completely bleached/desiccated (tan/straw colored) suggesting severe infection
- Striped/streaked pattern rather than discrete spots or lesions

**Reference comparison (Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv):**
- Clear match: the reference shows the same longitudinal yellow-green streaking pattern on sugarcane leaves, alternating with normal green tissue — exactly what the test image shows

The longitudinal stripe pattern following the leaf veins, combined with the progression to complete leaf bleaching in advanced cases, is characteristic of Sugarcane Streak Mosaic Virus (SCSMV).
